basic_info.description: A modern, spacious and immaculate 1BR/1BA in a great North Beach location. Beautiful hardwood floors, open floor plan, and kitchen with granite counters, Studio Becker cabinets and stainless steel appliances. There is also an in-unit washer and dryer, additional storage room and one car deeded independent parking. Building elevator. Wonderful common view roof terrace. Convenient to all the amazing North Beach bars and restaurants, the Embarcadero waterfront and more.
